import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    public static long square(long a) {
        return a * a;
    }

    public static long distanceSquared(long ax, long ay, long bx, long by) {
        return square(ax - bx) + square(ay - by);
    }

    static class Point {
        long[] coords;

        public Point(long... coords) {
            this.coords = coords;
        }

        public long lengthSquared() {
            long sum = 0;
            for (long c : coords) {
                sum += c * c;
            }
            return sum;
        }

        public long dotProduct(Point other) {
            long result = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < coords.length; i++) {
                result += this.coords[i] * other.coords[i];
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Point subtract(Point other) {
            long[] resultCoords = new long[coords.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < coords.length; i++) {
                resultCoords[i] = this.coords[i] - other.coords[i];
            }
            return new Point(resultCoords);
        }
    }

    public static boolean check(List<Point> points, int index) {
        Point current = points.get(index);
        int n = points.size();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (j == index) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if (k == index || k == j) continue;
                Point x = points.get(j).subtract(current);
                Point y = points.get(k).subtract(current);
                if (x.dotProduct(y) > 0) return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        if (n > 11) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            long[] coords = new long[5];
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                coords[j] = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
            }
            points.add(new Point(coords));
        }
        List<Integer> resultIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (check(points, i)) {
                resultIndices.add(i + 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(resultIndices.size());
        for (int idx : resultIndices) {
            System.out.println(idx);
        }
    }
}
